name: Booking.com dated hotel shortlist -> Google Sheets (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Booking.com hotel shortlist -> Google Sheets

This workflow runs the locked Luminar Booking.com Hotel Scraper once and upserts a dated, filterable property shortlist into Google Sheets. Every row stays tied to one destination, check-in, check-out, and requested currency context; it does not present search-card prices as checkout-verified quotes.

### How it works

1. A manual test or inactive daily schedule reaches one editable settings node.
2. Fail-closed preflight validates all placeholders, destination, dates, guests, enums, result/request/runtime limits, spreadsheet target, and maximum charge before paid work.
3. The exact Actor build runs once with automatic paid retry disabled.
4. n8n reads the Actor's documented OUTPUT summary, normalizes coverage and PPE accounting, and retrieves every intended property and coverage row through bounded pagination.
5. Stable Google Sheets keys use the locale-neutral canonical Booking property path + checkIn + checkOut + currency. Numeric-ID and path-fallback source routes therefore update the same row.

### Setup

- [ ] Install the verified Apify community node.
- [ ] Select the same Apify credential on both Apify nodes. The signed summary request needs no credential.
- [ ] Select a Google Sheets OAuth credential on the final destination node.
- [ ] Replace both date placeholders and the spreadsheet ID; confirm the sheet name.
- [ ] Before any paid run, copy row 1 exactly from workflows/sheets/booking-hotels-shortlist-header.csv into the target tab, then refresh the Google Sheets node columns.
- [ ] Run manually and inspect coverage, output rows, exact charge, and the materialized Sheet rows.
- [ ] Activate the schedule only after the bounded test is correct.

Verified empty output creates no Sheet row. Partial or failed coverage also creates no row. An intentional bounded cap may write useful rows, but every row and final receipt discloses the capped state.

## 1. Configure safely

Start manually or on an inactive schedule. One settings node and fail-closed preflight protect paid work and the Sheet destination.

nodes.name: Section 2 - Run once and read evidence

parameters.content:
## 2. Run once and read evidence

Runs the immutable Actor once without paid retry, classifies terminal status, and reads the documented OUTPUT summary.

## 3. Retrieve complete output

Normalizes coverage and exact PPE accounting, plans bounded pages, and retrieves all property plus coverage rows.

## 4. Build stable upserts

Reconciles counts and coverage, then creates route-independent keys from the normalized Booking property path, stay dates, and currency.

## 5. Write or stop honestly

Retries only Google Sheets delivery. Verified empty, partial, failed, and setup errors return explicit no-write receipts.
